map.查「曦」字读音与结构: Look up the pronunciation and structure of a character
map.输入「曦」：拼音 xī（一声），部首「日」，总笔画 20 画，左右结构，Unic: Enter xī: pinyin xī (1st tone), radical sun (rì), 20 total strokes, left-right structure, Unicode U+66E6; this places it under the sun radical with 16 remaining strokes, and helps confirm it is the common form meaning “morning light”.
